evidence.reason: The current implementation still deletes both retained counter entries in record_legacy_success whenever the family is not quarantined, without checking legacy_coverage_releases. After legacy_quarantine release records floors, a counted success can therefore erase the counters that legacy_retry_view compares against those floors, producing the floor-missing/reduced denial even though the release proofs are unchanged. Skipping deletion for released families is the minimal correctness repair; the retry view's reset handling already accounts for the success streak.
